statement: Pinned xpad selects Elite Series 2 input layouts by USB bcdDevice: below 0x0500 (early 4.x), 0x0500 through below 0x050b (early 5.x), and 0x050b or later (split paddle report). Early layouts read paddle flags from the main input packet, but the later layout reads them from a separate firmware-command report; all paths use four grip key codes and suppress independent paddle output under selected custom profile conditions.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.firmware: driver branches based on bcdDevice 0x0500 and 0x050b
applicability.scope: xpad.c:68-72, 1066-1083, 1165-1209, 2170-2195. Driver-selected layout, not proof of a particular device firmware or every future revision.
